**Describe the bug**

Trying new functionality **exponential backoff between self heal attempts** (https://github.com/argoproj/argo-cd/pull/20275) I have found out that the max delay is not calculated properly. In this block:

https://github.com/argoproj/argo-cd/blob/36d189c133b2b7b5dde8710fc8b877c1c2959d81/controller/appcontroller.go#L2146-L2148
when the calculated delay exceeds max (`controller.self.heal.backoff.cap.seconds`), the delay should be max (`controller.self.heal.backoff.cap.seconds`) but is isn't. In reality it is the previously calculated delay. So with the following configuration:
* no controller.self.heal.backoff.timeout.seconds (default: 2)
* no controller.self.heal.backoff.factor (default: 3)
